pages.text: The Chronocortex can grow a spyglass that looks $(o)backwards$(). Hold it to my eye and, through the round glass, the past stands where the present was, in faded sepia; around the glass, the present goes on.$(br2)It burns $(l)Time$(): its own store first (pour a Stasis Ampoule onto it), then my pool. A dram every two seconds, more for deeper looks.

pages.title: Careful
pages.text: What the glass shows is the past, $(l)not$() the present. A floor through the lens may be a hole now; rubble the lens wipes away is still there to trip over. Do not walk while looking.

pages.title: How Far Back
pages.text: Sneak and use it to change the setting.$(br)$(l)Echo$(): hours. Nothing yet.$(br)$(l)Decades$(): ruined laboratories with their lights still on.$(br)$(l)Centuries$(): older ruins, whole.$(br2)Something tells me it can see further still, if the Chronocortex grows.

pages.title: Eras
pages.text: Once I have stood in an era, the Lens can find it again. Past Centuries, sneaking and using it turns to each era I have visited: the same ground, as it was then. It costs more Time to look so far.
